Samantha — great to get the sample, and appreciate the explicit failure modes. High-level reply / plan below.

Summary of ask (we heard):
- Run a customer-specific eval focused on diagnosis extraction and hallucination checks.
- Validate PHI redaction and report any leakage.
- Recommend a model shortlist and provide scoring guide + threshold recommendations.

Quick answers:
- Dataset format: CSV with columns: id, visit_text, prompt, gold_label, label_type. The sample you sent is fine; the full upload should follow the same schema. If you have nested JSON (EHR fields) we accept newline-delimited JSON as well.
- Smoke run ETA: 2 business days after we receive the full 10k CSV. Full benchmark (end-to-end scoring + report) ETA: 8 business days (includes manual spot-checks).
- Suggested initial shortlist (based on call + problem type): open-llama-70b-q4, redwood-instruct-7b-int8, and a quantized Llama-2-13b variant. We'll include a fast, low-cost baseline (redwood-lite-3b) so you can compare unit economics. See attached model recommendation brief.

Scoring proposal (draft):
- Primary metric: strict precision at entity-level for diagnosis extraction (exact-match after normalization).
- Secondary: false positive rate for hallucinated procedures/meds (count per 1k tokens).
- Safety: PHI token leakage checks (regex-based and random manual audit of 1% of outputs).
- Pass/fail thresholds: Precision >= 0.88 to move to pilot; FP rate <= 0.02 per 1k tokens. These are starting points — happy to iterate.

Next steps / owners:
- Samantha: upload full eval CSV to the Drive link (please add HubSpot record HS-11245 to the upload) — due by Fri 21 May.
- Chloe: kick off smoke run once data is available; share initial logs and the benchmark link (ETA 2 business days after upload).
- Ben: validate cost/billing estimate for the 10k-run and include Dedicated vs Hosted delta.
- Jordan: prepare scorer deck and manual spot-check rubric; will coordinate with Harbor clinical SMEs for 1% audit.

If others want to propose alternate metrics (e.g., relaxed match or token-F1), call that out and we can run additional columns in the report.
